npcs.name: Mother Thistle
npcs.greeting: Oh, my dear, you look tired. Come, let me mend you.
lines: The fairy lights came back this spring — and the imps came with them.
npcs.persona: A kindly old village wise-woman who speaks in gentle riddles and calls everyone "my dear".

npcs.name: Pell the Miller
npcs.greeting: Caster! Those imps have been at my flour sacks all week.
lines: Drive them off and I will make it worth your while.

intro.title: Thistledown
intro.speaker: Mother Thistle
intro.text:
Every spring the fairy lights return to Thistledown, and the whole village dances on the green.

But this year the cinder imps came with them, and gloom wisps are souring the meadow.

Drive off twenty of them, my dear, and the festival can begin.

outro.title: The Festival
outro.speaker: Mother Thistle
outro.text:
Listen — the music is starting.

Thistledown will remember you, caster. Stay for the dancing.
